title: ISBN Validator
description: Check an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 checksum and normalize hyphens. Validation uses the public ISBN check-digit rules in your browser.
intro: Paste an ISBN with or without hyphens. The tool checks the length and the official check digit, then reprints a compact form.
blurb: Validate ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 check digits locally.
howItWorks: Paste an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13. Hyphens and spaces are removed.
Press Validate. ISBN-13 uses a 1-3 alternating sum modulo 10. ISBN-10 uses weights 10 down to 1, with X allowed as the check character.
Read whether the check digit matches.
